title: What actually makes knowledge propagate: status is inert, the fidelity channel produces yield (pre-registered BEFORE running)
terminology_note: Functional/engineering terms only. No cultural or religious lexicon. The extracted logic is used as a case study in governance methodology: capacity/status U, encoding fidelity D_enc (local sifting), decoding fidelity D_dec (downstream propagation/verifiability), realized yield E, two-source independence (VIF), decoupled evaluation.
thesis: Modern practice accelerates SEARCH -- brute-forcing billions of candidates. The claim under test is different and prior to speed: raw capacity/status (reputation, stars, likes, size, team) is THERMODYNAMICALLY INERT on its own, and realized knowledge yield is PRODUCED by a two-hop fidelity channel E = U * D_enc * D_dec. If true, the route to knowledge breakthroughs is to SECURE THE CHANNEL first; applying speed to an unverified channel only accelerates the propagation of noise. This is a claim about METHOD, not speed, and each gate is falsifiable.
data_integrity_disclosure: IMPORTANT AND DELIBERATE. The four substrates carrying the empirical gates are REAL and frozen (GitHub, Hugging Face, bioRxiv, PubMed). The N=793 'knowledge cohort' fixture committed in this repository (repro/data/se_fixture_barakah.json) is SYNTHETIC -- its own provenance block declares synthetic:true, seed 20260720, ground_truth 'additive linear latent, no D^2; hops independent'. It is therefore used ONLY as a labelled POSITIVE CONTROL that validates the estimators against known ground truth, and it contributes ZERO real-world evidence. Any narrative that cites this committed fixture as real Stack Exchange measurement is corrected here.

substrates.github: 28 real most-starred repos (frozen github-lism fixture). status U = stars. realized yield = forks (actual downstream reuse). D_enc = backlog health = 1/(1 + open_issues/median_open_issues) [uses NO outcome field]. D_dec = fork-through = forks/stars [uses the outcome, so it is used ONLY in the independence gate K2 and in K4, NEVER in the K1 yield regression -- circularity is avoided by construction].
substrates.huggingface: 19 real media-gen models (frozen hf-media fixture). status U = likes. realized yield = downloads. D_enc = license clarity in {0.9 permissive, 0.5 restrictive, 0.25 unknown}. D_dec = 0.3 + 0.6*[has eval_results]. Neither fidelity leg uses downloads, so the full two-hop product is admissible in K1.
substrates.biorxiv: 40 real preprints (frozen biorxiv-lism fixture). capacity = n_authors (team size). fidelity = publication-latency fidelity 1/(1 + days/365). Single-leg substrate.
substrates.pubmed: 8 real MeSH clinical fields (frozen pubmed-lism fixture). capacity = total publications (field size). fidelity = integrity = 1 - retracted/total. Single-leg substrate, N=8 (small-N caveat declared up front).
substrates.synthetic_control: the committed N=793 knowledge fixture -- SYNTHETIC, labelled, estimator validation only.

gates.K1_fidelity_beats_status: CENTRAL CLAIM. On Hugging Face, does fidelity-adjusted capacity explain realized yield better than raw status alone? Compare Spearman rank correlation with downloads of (a) likes alone vs (b) likes * D_enc * D_dec. PASS iff rho_b > rho_a. FALSIFIABLE BOTH WAYS: if raw status explains yield at least as well, that is a reported NULL against the thesis on this substrate, stated at full force and never retuned. GitHub is reported alongside using only the non-circular leg (stars vs stars*D_enc against forks) as a second, independent read.
gates.K2_independence_gate: CHANNEL INTACT. On the two substrates with two genuine fidelity legs (GitHub, Hugging Face) the measured VIF(D_enc, D_dec) must be < 1.10 -- the two hops carry independent information, so the two-hop product is non-degenerate rather than one leg re-certifying the other. Deterministic control: a self-certifying node whose D_dec is a copy of its D_enc must be REJECTED (VIF >= 5.0, the standard collinearity gate). PASS iff both real substrates are intact AND the circular control is rejected. DECLARED UP FRONT: bioRxiv and PubMed are single-leg substrates, so the independence gate is UNTESTABLE there -- stated, not forced.
gates.K3_capacity_does_not_confer_fidelity: STATUS IS INERT. Raw capacity should not, by itself, buy channel fidelity. Measure Spearman rho between capacity and fidelity on the two single-leg real substrates: PubMed (field size vs integrity) and bioRxiv (team size vs latency fidelity). PASS iff NEITHER shows a strong positive coupling (rho <= 0.50 on both). FALSIFIABLE: a strong positive rho would mean bigger/richer nodes DO buy fidelity, contradicting the thesis, and must be reported as such. Exact rho values reported either way. PubMed N=8 is a declared small-N limit.
gates.K4_decoupled_evaluation: F_out = F_eval ON KNOWLEDGE. Ranking by self-reported status must differ from ranking by verified fidelity, and at least one top-5 status node must sit BELOW the fidelity floor (Hugging Face floor: min hop < 0.28; GitHub floor: min hop < 0.30). PASS iff the rankings differ AND >= 1 popular-but-below-floor node exists on Hugging Face. Governance reading: a knowledge network that allocates by prestige misallocates.
gates.K5_estimator_positive_control: SYNTHETIC CONTROL, NO REAL-WORLD CLAIM. On the committed synthetic N=793 fixture whose declared ground truth is 'additive linear latent, hops independent', the estimators must recover that ground truth: the two hops measure as independent (VIF < 1.10). PASS iff recovered. This validates the measurement code ONLY; it is explicitly NOT evidence about any real knowledge network.

symmetric_null: Every rho, every VIF, every ranking comparison is reported AS-IS with its exact value. K1 and K3 are genuinely empirical and MAY come out against the thesis; such a result is a valid, reported outcome and will never be retuned into a win. Declared limits: PubMed N=8; bioRxiv survivor-only (all published) and single-leg; GitHub D_dec is outcome-derived and therefore excluded from K1 by construction; the N=793 knowledge fixture is synthetic and carries no real-world weight.
acceptance: GREEN when the spec re-hashes to the manifest, the five fixtures re-hash to their pins, and K1-K5 are evaluated exactly as written -- with any null or falsification reported at full force rather than suppressed. No post-hoc gate changes.
honest_scope: This tests whether fidelity, not status, tracks realized knowledge yield on real open-source, model-hosting, preprint and clinical-bibliometric substrates. It does NOT claim to produce a scientific breakthrough, does NOT claim superhuman capability, and is NOT a speed result. It is a methodology claim: secure the channel first, then speed is safe to apply. Complements the discovery pipeline (PR #104), triage substrates (#105), decoupling capstone (#106), constitutional allocator (#107), biomedical case study (#108) and the device-independent Bell certifier (#109).
